thread:
Maya: Quick check-in  vendors pushed new ETA for Gaudi and MI300. We need a clear cross-region signal plan before flipping marketplace SKUs.
Omar: TL;DR: Gaudi APAC driver -> +11 days. MI300 EU perf patch -> maybe +4 days. H100/H200/B200 look stable.
Felix: Can we use a single "announce-signal" flag per SKU that reads from SI cert + perf gate? That would simplify ops.
Hannah: Yes, but Marketing needs a human approval step for press. System flips ok for marketplace, press must be locked until comms says go.
Maya: Proposal: two signals: "marketplace-ready" (automated) and "press-go" (manual by Comms). Marketplace-ready requires SI=true AND 48h canary green.
Omar: SI will emit cert boolean per region. I'll add a "stability-window" timestamp so ops can evaluate the 48h.
Felix: Ops question: how granular should the SKU gating be? per-region, per-instance-type? e.g., H100-48g vs H100-80g?
Hannah: Marketing prefers per-region + per-model family. We can avoid instance-size splits in the first wave. Simpler messaging.
Maya: Draft runbook snippet for flipping (ops):
```
- Precheck: SI cert flag == true for region
- Start 48h canary: route 1% traffic to "announce-canary" pool
- Monitor latency, error_rate, and model-quality tests
- If canary green -> set marketplace-ready=true
- Comms reviews -> set press-go=true
```
Omar: SI will publish cert events to webhook: /integrations/si/certs. Recommend we add a small payload: {"sku":"Gaudi","region":"apac","cert_ts":"2026-04-28T04:00Z","notes":"fw-1.2.3"}.
Felix: Runtime: we'll add telemetry tag "announce_canary=true" plus a counter metric for fallbacks. Also auto-fallback to quantized B200 when latency > SLO for 5m.
OpsBot: Action created: PART-3344 allocate announce-canary pools (2x GPU APAC, 1x EU). Assigned to @infra-run.
Hannah: Comms: we'll gate press-go until legal approves partner quotes. Also ask partners not to publish embargoed materials until we flip press-go.
PartnerLiaison: I'll loop in vendor PMs and ask them to coordinate their press dates with us. Also request that OEMs not publish "global" availability.
Maya: Edge case: if SI cert shows flaky (intermittent errors), we keep marketplace-ready=false and run extended canary. Don't flip on intermittent certs.
Omar: Noted. SI will include a pass_rate field. Use threshold pass_rate >= 95% for auto flip.
Felix: Ops will implement a holdback in Console UI showing "Marketplace availability pending SI certification" with a tooltip summarizing canary progress.
Hannah: Good. I'll prepare two embargo templates: one for single-region announce and one for wave announce. Share by EOD.
Maya: Final action list:
- Omar: push per-region cert webhook + pass_rate field (EOD)
- Felix: implement telemetry tags + auto-fallback rule (2 days)
- OpsBot/@infra-run: allocate canary pools PART-3344 (now)
- Hannah: embargo templates + partner note (EOD)
- PartnerLiaison: confirm vendor press blackout until press-go (tomorrow)

Maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if SI cert dates shift again. Ping me direct for urgent blockers.
